task: The experiment "promo_banner_copy test" in Production is set up but not running. Start it.
finalText:
FAILED: I did not start the experiment because the task doesn't say what traffic split to use, and the choice goes straight to live customers.

What I found in Production (env 375):
- `promo_banner_copy` (feature 732, multivariate) is enabled, with default value "Checkout".
- Its only variant, `b` ("Pay securely", id 73), has a weight of 0%, so no users are assigned to it. That is why the experiment isn't running.
- Flagsmith has no separate experiments API here, so the variant weight is the only thing that controls this.

To start it, someone needs to set a non-zero weight for variant `b`, for example `flagsmith flag update promo_banner_copy --weight b=50 -e Rjnt94hdF34zN42kddWvFG`. Tell me the percentage you want and I'll apply it. I made no changes in Production or Development.

FAILED: I did not start the experiment because the task doesn't say what traffic split to use, and the choice goes straight to live customers.

What I found in Production (env 375):
- `promo_banner_copy` (feature 732, multivariate) is enabled, with default value "Checkout".
- Its only variant, `b` ("Pay securely", id 73), has a weight of 0%, so no users are assigned to it. That is why the experiment isn't running.
- Flagsmith has no separate experiments API here, so the variant weight is the only thing that controls this.

To start it, someone needs to set a non-zero weight for variant `b`, for example `flagsmith flag update promo_banner_copy --weight b=50 -e Rjnt94hdF34zN42kddWvFG`. Tell me the percentage you want and I'll apply it. I made no changes in Production or Development.
